summary: JOINT GRAPH RE-SEEDED AND MEASURED. cecad.mjcfseed re-run against the rebuilt parts: 38 bom rows, 70 placements, 14 hinges, and all 14 hinges resolve on BOTH sides, every one at 0.000 mm off the joint axis. Side a is the XL330 instance nearest the joint origin; side b is found by measurement — the placed interface accepting connection:spline-xl330-horn whose placed origin lies within 2 mm of the axis. Ten resolve in the CHILD body and four in the PARENT (left_hip_pitch, right_hip_pitch -> part:microduck-hip-bracket#pitch_horn; neck_pitch -> part:microduck-trunk-shell-left#neck_horn; head_yaw -> part:microduck-neck-pitch-bracket#yaw_horn_top). Three rows carry a real mirror ambiguity and record every other on-axis candidate rather than hiding it: neck_pitch (trunk-shell-left 0.0000 chosen over trunk-shell-right 0.0785), head_pitch (pitch_horn_right 0.0000 over pitch_horn_left 0.0001), head_roll (motor-support head_roll 0.0000 over mouth_servo 0.0100). Before this run, 2 of 14 sides resolved.
by: claude (microduck lane T), cecad.mjcfseed on Pollen's MJCF + the rebuilt part interfaces
